content: महिषी .²1 A she-buffalo, buffalo-cow; <ls>Ms. 9. 55</ls>; माषानष्टौ तु महिषी सस्यघातस्य कारिणी <ls>Y. 2. 159</ls>. .²2 The principal queen, queen-consort; महिषीसखः <ls>R. 1. 48</ls>, <ls n="R.">2. 25</ls>, <ls n="R.">3. 9</ls>. .²3 A queen in general. .²4 The female of a bird; सासज्जत शिचस्तन्त्यां महिषी कालयन्त्रिता <ls>Bhāg. 7. 2. 52</ls>. .²5 A ladyʼs maid, female servant (सैरन्ध्री). .²6 An immoral woman. .²7 Money acquired by the prostitution of oneʼs wife; <ab>cf.</ab> माहिषिक.
